task_spec.goal: Fix the invoice_total bug in billing.py so the coupon is applied to the pre-tax subtotal, line items are summed exactly without per-line rounding, and the final charge is rounded half up to cents once at the end; add pytest tests asserting each check's expected value.
acceptance_criteria: Coupon is subtracted from the pre-tax subtotal before tax is computed.
Line items are summed exactly (no per-line rounding to cents before summing).
The final charge is rounded half up to cents exactly once at the end.
pytest tests assert each check's expected value and pass.
step_by_step_plan: Read billing.py and issue.md to understand the current invoice_total implementation.
Refactor invoice_total to sum line items exactly (use Decimal or exact arithmetic, no intermediate rounding).
Apply the coupon to the pre-tax subtotal, then compute tax on the reduced subtotal.
Round the final total half up to cents exactly once using Decimal quantize with ROUND_HALF_UP.
Create tests/test_billing.py with pytest cases asserting the expected values for Case 1, Case 2, and the edge cases.
Run pytest and confirm all checks pass.
task_spec.notes: Use decimal.Decimal throughout to avoid binary float rounding errors. Rounding must be ROUND_HALF_UP applied only to the final total, not to individual line items or intermediate values.
